title: [KV Pool][BugFix] Remove MemCache DP initialization barrier
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

Revert #17289 because the MemCache DP initialization barrier is no longer needed. Remove the CPU process-group barrier after MemCache store initialization, its configuration propagation through `AscendStoreConnector` and `KVPoolWorker`, and the barrier-specific tests. Clean up the deployment guide, GLM5.3-Flash examples, and Chinese translations that reference the removed option. Document that the MemCache pooling backend requires both `memcache-hybrid >= 1.3.0` and `memfabric-hybrid >= 1.3.0`, including version constraints in the installation commands and matching Chinese translations.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. MemCache initialization no longer waits for a DP process-group barrier. The `kv_connector_extra_config.memcache_dp_init_barrier` option is removed and should be removed from deployment configurations.

Release note: `release_notes/fragments/19370.yaml`.

### How was this patch tested?

- Single signed-off commit based on main `041cfb328c0628b1fc17db5c55b8d374e6363466`. Verified the exact published commit with the same fetch-and-rebase step used by CPU CI: rebase succeeds without conflicts and preserves the tested tree. This avoids replaying the conflicting pre-merge barrier-removal commit.
- On 80.5.9.133 in an isolated development checkout, CPU/mocked scheduler, backend, connector, and worker suites: **349 passed, 2 deselected**.
- Command: `TORCH_DEVICE_BACKEND_AUTOLOAD=0 python3 -m pytest -q -rs --confcutdir=tests/ut/distributed/ascend_store tests/ut/distributed/ascend_store/test_pool_scheduler.py tests/ut/distributed/ascend_store/test_backend.py tests/ut/distributed/ascend_store/test_ascend_store_connector.py tests/ut/distributed/ascend_store/test_pool_worker.py -k 'not test_joint_prefix_group_ownership_survives_scheduler_conversion_and_empty_pp_layer_names'`.
- The two excluded existing ownership-conversion cases require `vllm.v1.core.kv_cache_planning`, absent from the installed vLLM. Full upstream CPU testing remains for CI with aligned dependencies.
- `bash format.sh ci`: all hooks passed. `git diff --check` against the main base passed. The published tree matches the locally tested and formatted tree.
- The MemCache deployment guide and Chinese translations document `memcache-hybrid >= 1.3.0` and `memfabric-hybrid >= 1.3.0`; installation commands quote these version constraints.
- Existing backend tests cover retained behavior; barrier-specific tests are removed with the feature. No NPU multi-rank startup or end-to-end serving validation was run. No production services were modified or restarted.

### Checklist

- [x] Boundary / edge-case coverage reviewed; this reverts the removed feature and retains existing backend tests.
- [ ] Regression test added.
- [ ] Error / failure path execution completed.
- [x] Meaningful & reliable tests executed.
- [ ] Performance impact validated on Ascend hardware.

- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/544f182d9f0c9bfe8bd7645525951d5e3692a542
